title: Function coverage for Write Single Coil
purpose: Cover the addressed coil-write path with a valid legal ON value to exercise a boolean-output parser branch distinct from register-oriented operations.
expected_behavior: The endpoint should parse function 0x05, target coil address 0x0013, and process the documented legal OFF value 0x0000, typically echoing the request on success or returning a standard exception if the address is not supported.
constraints_preserved: MBAP Length is 0006, matching unit identifier plus 5-byte PDU.
Function 0x05 is used as documented for Write Single Coil.
The output value uses a documented legal coil encoding: 0x0000 for OFF.
Unit identifier, transaction identifier, and payload values are diversified from the other seeds.
issue_safety_notes: This is a fully valid coil-write request using a documented legal value and avoids malformed or historical collision payloads.
